properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Idea D5 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, 2026-09-29. Anthony, mid-exercise: "You might need 2 agents to do this properly. One that interfaces with reflow2 and one that acts as the human user."

WHAT ONE RUN SHOWED (three rounds, flo2 design 50f966697d6c5024). One agent playing both roles had settled its own recommendations. The separate owner then:
- found facts-per-design off by 2× against two real exports;
- stopped "build the rules layer" from meaning "write a Datalog engine from scratch";
- refused a Protocol Buffers pin with a fallback clause, citing prost #1031;
- showed that storing the blast radius would break the memory budget;
- withdrew its own provisional answer when the evidence came in.
Cost: the designer took about 610 tool calls over 3 rounds, the owner 6–17 calls and about 3 minutes per round. Almost all of the cost was tool friction, not judgement.

OPTIONS, none chosen:
(a) NOTHING. It is a way to run agents, not a feature of reflow2. The harness's subagents already do it.
(b) A SERVED SKILL ("two-party" or a mode of genesis): who the parties are, what each may and may not call, how questions and answers cross, and that the owner's word is recorded with the owner linked.
(c) (b) plus the records that make it cheap: an addressed question batch (companion D2), an addressed digest (D3), agent-for-principal provenance (D1), and a delegation boundary (D4). Without them the mode's cost is the hand relay measured here.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS KEPT.
· An owner AGENT is the same model family as the designer, so blind spots are correlated. It caught errors of arithmetic, evidence and wording, not a wrong goal. It is no substitute for the person whose design it is.
· It can become approval theatre: two agents agreeing reads like review.
· rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word says an agent settles nothing. An owner agent settling under delegation needs that rule to say whether a delegation counts, which is the D4 question.

SIZE: (a) free. (b) a skill. (c) is the sum of D1–D4.
properties.name: OPEN — should reflow2 serve a two-party way of working (a DESIGNER that drafts, recommends and records, and a separate OWNER that only reads, judges and decides, human or agent) as a skill, now that one run measured what the second party catches that self-approval does not?
properties.rationale: Anthony asked for this triage expressly to "learn things to improve in reflow2 and flo2" from the two-agent run. This records the run's own shape as a candidate way of working, with its measured benefit and its correlated-blind-spot limit beside it.
